map.name: Brackenford
map.trouble: Red Corwin's bandits hold the old watchtower on Crow Hill and rob the north road, so Halvard has shut the north gate.

guard_bark.specifics: Garrick keeps the north gate, shut by Halvard against Red Corwin's bandits.

first.speaker: Garrick
first.text: Hardly anybody comes up to this gate these days.

again.speaker: Garrick
again.text: Back to town with you, stranger! Have a pleasant day!

later.speaker: Garrick
later.text: Very well. It's open. Go on.

bounty_offer.specifics: Ulric, an old shepherd at the edge of the Ashwood, wants the Wolves that took his sheep killed.

offer.speaker: Ulric
offer.text:
Help! Please, help me! A pack of grey Wolves just came down out of the Ashwood, behind my fold and dragged off nearly half of my sheep! One of them was my fine old ram, Barley!

Please put an end to those Wolves and you'll have a reward!

reminder.speaker: Ulric
reminder.text: Oh why are you still standing here? My flock gets smaller every night!

completion.speaker: Ulric
completion.text: Oh, bless you, brave Adventurer! Here, these are for you!

journal.text: Kill the Wolves raiding Ulric's flock at the edge of the Ashwood.

heirloom_fetch.specifics: Wenna, the miller's widow, wants the Amulet of Plenty back from the Urchins of the old barrow, and her hired man Tobin, who went after it.

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
While the rest of Brackenford frets over Red Corwin, there's a smaller job which I need done.

Tobin, my hired man, chased the Urchins who broke into the mill last night and took the Amulet of Plenty.

Those Urchins have burrowed into the old barrow east of the ford. Tobin went in after them. He hasn't come out.

Will you bring the Amulet back to me and find out what became of Tobin?

refusal.speaker: Wenna
refusal.text: Fine then, leave my amulet with those thieving Urchins!

reminder.speaker: Wenna
reminder.text: Off to that barrow with you! Hurry!

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text:
You found the Amulet of Plenty! Wonderful!

My worst fears for Tobin, however, have come to pass. I'll miss the old goat, but we have no time for weeping. Reeve Halvard needs help with Red Corwin and has been asking for you.

Take this, with my thanks!

after.speaker: Wenna
after.text: Thanks again for bringing back my amulet, lad.

journal.text: Recover the Amulet of Plenty the Urchins stole from Wenna's mill.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover the Amulet of Plenty the Urchins stole from Wenna's mill.

rumour.specifics: Three townsfolk: a joke about Red Corwin, praise after the Wolves, a brush-off.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: I wonder who cuts Red Corwin's hair?

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Good work with the wolves, stranger! I hear old Ulric is very grateful!

shop_greeting.specifics: Ossian of the Drowned Lantern, Dunstan the smith, Mabry the potion seller.

inn.speaker: Ossian
inn.text: This is the Drowned Lantern. I can't promise the beds are dry, stranger.

arms.speaker: Dunstan
arms.text: Out of my forge, stranger! I don't sell blades to BANDITS!

magic.speaker: Mabry
magic.text: I hear the wolves are coming right up to the mill now. Time I thought about selling my potions somewhere else.

two_givers.specifics: Halvard wants the tithe chest back from Red Corwin's bandits; Sly Wat, a turncoat, wants an ale for what he knows of Corwin's tower.

offer_a.speaker: Halvard
offer_a.text:
Greetings, brave Adventurer! This town has been robbed blind in a shameless bandit raid!

Will you please bring back the tithe chest Red Corwin's men stole? If you do, you shall be well paid, because the good Brothers of the Chapel of the Ford cannot eat without it!

offer_b.speaker: Sly Wat
offer_b.text: You, again. Will you think it over, buy me an ale and hear what I know about Corwin's tower?

outcome_a.speaker: Halvard
outcome_a.text:
It's done, then! The tithe chest is safe in the Moot Hall again!

Take this shield, though. You have more than earned it!

Corwin's men still hold the watchtower, but I hear one of those filthy bandits drinks at the Drowned Lantern. If you ask around there maybe you can find a way in!

outcome_b.speaker: Sly Wat
outcome_b.text: Shame to hear that. I hope you think again soon, for I fear Corwin's lads are getting wise to me. I saw one of them sniffing around the inn a short while back.

journal_a.text: Recover the tithe chest stolen by Red Corwin's bandits.

journal_b.text: Buy Sly Wat an ale at the Drowned Lantern.

rescue.specifics: Brother Anselm's novice Pip chased the Urchins into the old barrow east of the ford and is lost there.

plea.speaker: Anselm
plea.text:
Please, help me, Wanderer! My young novice, Pip, chased the Urchins into the old barrow east of the ford and he's lost down there in the dark!

Find him and I'll be in your debt forever!

reminder.speaker: Anselm
reminder.text: Whatever those Urchins have piled up down there is yours! Just hurry and bring Pip back!

found.speaker: Pip
found.text: All right! I'm coming with you! Just get me away from these Urchins!

following.speaker: Pip
following.text: Quick! Take me back to the Chapel!

completion.speaker: Anselm
completion.text:
Praise be, you found him! How can the Chapel ever reward such courage?!

What's that you say? A great big sack of gold? Well, if that's your price, please accept this with the Chapel's blessing.

journal.text: Bring Brother Anselm's novice, Pip, back from the Urchins' barrow.

main_opening.specifics: A townsman sends the player to Halvard in the Moot Hall, who sends him against Red Corwin on Crow Hill.

opening.speaker: Halvard
opening.text:
You came at last. Good. Your first job for this town is a grave one.

Something foul is afoot along the Bracken. Robberies on the north road is getting worse by the week.

My efforts to bargain with the outlaw have come to nothing. Red Corwin laughs at my letters. You can help me put a stop to it.

The old watchtower on Crow Hill has not been manned in many years. My spies tell me the bandits keep two things up there which are crucial to their hold on the road. The first is Red Corwin himself, the second is the Horn of the Watch.

If you can see to these things for me, quickly, I hope the north gate may be opened again.

reminder.speaker: Halvard
reminder.text: No news yet? Well, keep after them up on Crow Hill. Corwin and that horn must be dealt with at once!

journal.text: Defeat Red Corwin for Reeve Halvard.
